pages.self:name: Self
pages.self:personal_group.comment:
Group Personal 
 Answer the question correctly to join by yourself. For the answer, scroll back up and check who this website is about. 
 No disturbances (no inexplicable {'@'}All Members, no group to-dos posted either). 
 Topics are miscellaneous—might talk about anything. 
 More people doesn't necessarily mean more liveliness; it's fine if you don't get it.
pages.self:description:1.1: Not very lively. Quite boring, actually. Don't react much to most things. Not good at talking. Not good at chatting. Not good at expressing myself.
pages.self:description:1.2: A bit slow. Might need more time and thinking in certain situations. Please don't despise me...
pages.self:description:1.3: Open to adding friends, but not recommended.
pages.self:description:1.4: Don't play any popular games. Don't ask. Often busy. No teaming up, no voice chat either.
pages.self:description:1.5: Not good at chatting either. Won't reply much to boring stuff. A lot of the time, my answers are just perfunctory.
pages.self:description:1.6: You can add me. You can sit silently on my friends list. You can ask questions. But no guarantee there'll be a solution.
pages.self:description:2.1: Maybe no real triggers. Hardly any emotional fluctuations. It's fine if you unfriend me; we can re-add later.
pages.self:description:2.2: But don't want small talk either. Or those random pokes/stickers with nothing else said. Or good morning/good night greetings. Very boring.
pages.self:description:2.3: If you interrupt something I'm doing, I might snap at you. Not actually angry though. Just try messaging at another time.
pages.self:description:3.1: Real identity is hidden by default. You can look it up quietly.
pages.self:description:3.2: But don't come straight up asking me anything about my real self. Won't acknowledge you. Won't answer.
pages.self:description:3.3: And don't shove already-public info in my face. Very boring.
pages.self:description:4.1: There are exceptions, including but not limited to close acquaintances. Unpredictable though. And when I occasionally don't feel like dealing with anyone, all of the above still applies.
pages.self:description:5.1: No sexting. No hookups. Not gay. No dating. Not looking for a partner. Won't be your partner.
pages.self:description:5.2: Don't smoke. Don't drink heavily. Can't play mahjong.
pages.self:description:6.2: Love milk tea. Especially into GOODME (?).
